card.name: "Known as" before a place's later name
card.fires_on: The word "as" (or similar like "named", "its") right after "known", "designated", or "used" when describing a place, building or region and what it became or was used for.

modes.label: Known as a place name
modes.description: "as" after "known" or "became known" introducing the name of a place or region.
modes.example: Limehouse and Pennyfields became known<< as>> Chinatown, and many of its inhabitants

modes.label: Designated or used as
modes.description: "as" or "named" after a verb describing a site's role, purpose or naming.
modes.example: Since 1886 members of the Jekyll Island Club had owned Jekyll Island using it<< as>> a winter hunting and vacation spot.

card.writes: Weakly favors odd mixed-language tokens and suppresses landscape nouns like roads, trees and mountains; no clear meaning.
card.plain: It fires on the little word "as" when a text says a place was known as, or used as, something else.
